title: Maternal Health Service Delivery Modeling
preview: Using multi-agent modeling to simulate how referral pathways, community trust, facility readiness, and implementation constraints shape maternal and neonatal outcomes in health system redesign efforts.

preview: Developing a data-informed method to instantiate calibrated dynamic models from qualitative causal maps for forecasting, counterfactual analysis, and intervention evaluation.

title: Latent Population Estimation for HIV Surveillance
preview: Integrating census, survey, and surveillance data to estimate hard-to-measure priority HIV populations for resource allocation and public health planning.

title: Expert-Informed Causal Structure Elicitation
preview: Using participatory modeling and stakeholder engagement to elicit causal assumptions, feedback loops, implementation barriers, and context-specific mechanisms.

title: Decision-Support Tools for Policy Evaluation
preview: Building interactive tools that translate model outputs, uncertainty, and intervention scenarios into accessible information for planning and decision-making.

title: Experimental Survey Methods for Smoking Cessation
